num_nurses: <int> Total number of nurses available for scheduling.
num_weeks: <int> Number of weeks in the planning horizon.
num_days: <int> Total number of days in the planning horizon (seven times the number of weeks).
num_shifts: <int> Number of distinct shift types per day.
skills: <list[str], length num_skills> Names of the nursing skills that can be performed.

shifts.name: <str> Name of the shift.
shifts.CS_minus: <int> Minimum number of consecutive days a nurse should work this same shift once started.
shifts.CS_plus: <int> Maximum number of consecutive days a nurse should work this same shift.

forbidden_shift_successions: <list[list[str]], length varies> Pairs of shifts where a nurse working the first shift on one day may not work the second shift on the following day.

penalty_weights.c_S1: <int> Per-nurse penalty for each unit of shortfall below optimal staffing coverage.
penalty_weights.c_S2a: <int> Per-day penalty for each day a consecutive-worked-days stretch deviates from its bounds.
penalty_weights.c_S2b: <int> Per-day penalty for each day a consecutive-same-shift stretch deviates from its bounds.
penalty_weights.c_S3: <int> Per-day penalty for each day a consecutive-days-off stretch deviates from its bounds.
penalty_weights.c_S4: <int> Penalty incurred each time a nurse is assigned to one of their preferred-off day-shift pairs.
penalty_weights.c_S5: <int> Penalty incurred when a nurse works only one of the two days of a weekend.
penalty_weights.c_S6: <int> Per-day penalty for each day a nurse's total worked days deviates from the allowed range.
penalty_weights.c_S7: <int> Per-weekend penalty for each weekend a nurse works beyond the allowed maximum.

nurses.name: <str> Display name of the nurse.
nurses.skills: <list[str], length varies> Skills this nurse is qualified to perform.

contract.L_minus: <int> Minimum total number of days the nurse should work over the planning horizon.
contract.L_plus: <int> Maximum total number of days the nurse should work over the planning horizon.
contract.CD_minus: <int> Minimum number of consecutive worked days in any uninterrupted work stretch.
contract.CD_plus: <int> Maximum number of consecutive worked days in any uninterrupted work stretch.
contract.CR_minus: <int> Minimum number of consecutive days off in any rest period.
contract.CR_plus: <int> Maximum number of consecutive days off in any rest period.
contract.WE_plus: <int> Maximum number of weekends the nurse should work over the planning horizon.

preferences.day: <int> Day index (0-based) of the preferred-off assignment.
preferences.shift: <str> Shift name of the preferred-off assignment.

{skill_name}.minimum: <int> Minimum number of nurses with this skill required on this shift and day (hard constraint).
{skill_name}.optimal: <int> Desired number of nurses with this skill on this shift and day (shortfalls are penalized).
